pages.text: Early each morning, ducks crossed the river in a line. Once the sun rose higher, they were already gone.
Bung turned toward the bow. "I will show you those ducks, Ddori. Quick, let us go!"
Ddori wore one shoe. The other was still in a hand.
Bung pulled Ddori by the arm. Ddori toddled along, being pulled.
At the boat edge, the shoe dropped from Ddori's hand. It floated on the water.
Bung watched it, stamping both feet. The water was out of reach.
Grandpa lifted the wet shoe with a long stick. The ducks were already far away.
He shook off the shoe. "Shoes on first."
Next morning, Bung crouched before Ddori and waited until both shoes were on.
The ducks crossed the river in a line. Ddori clapped both hands.
